fields.description: The Scarlet Web: An Elite superhero themed Chocolate Square Cake -
A romantic 1kg heart-shaped chocolate cake, lavishly adorned with a complete tapestry of exquisite buttercream roses in varying shades of pink and rose, perfect for an anniversary. -
A dreamy 1kg Barbie Pink Chocolate Cake, a perfect blend of elegance and playful sparkle for Ammu's special birthday! -
Swing into a web-tastic celebration with this perfectly crafted, vibrant Spiderman chocolate cake, designed for the ultimate fan! -
fields.baker_message: i will make ur birday wonderful

fields.description: A romantic 1kg round chocolate cake, elegantly frosted in pastel pink with shimmering hearts and a gleaming '25' candle, perfect for a milestone anniversary celebration. -
An exquisite 3kg, three-tier white chocolate wedding cake, adorned with delicate edible lace, pearl details, and crowned with a classic bride and groom topper, embodying timeless elegance. -
A heroic 0.5kg round chocolate cake, vibrantly red, featuring the iconic Superman 'S' shield and a personalized birthday message for Appu. -
